# ParaWerk kernel (prebuilt)

WebAssembly build of ParaWerk's geometry kernel: the C++ facade in `native/kernel/src` (`core.cpp`: OCCT logic, `bindings.cpp`: WebAssembly bindings)
compiled with Emscripten against Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT).

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `parawerk-kernel.js`, `parawerk-kernel.wasm` | The kernel module (ES module, Emscripten runtime) |
| `parawerk-kernel.d.ts` | TypeScript declarations generated by Emscripten |
| `manifest.json` | OCCT and Emscripten versions, build time and SHA-256 checksums |
| `OCCT_LICENSE_LGPL_21.txt`, `OCCT_LGPL_EXCEPTION.txt` | OCCT license |

Rebuild from source (about one hour the first time):

```bash
scripts/build-occt.sh     # Emscripten + OCCT static libraries in ~/.cache/parawerk-build
scripts/build-kernel.sh   # compiles the facade and updates this folder
```
